layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Carnivore diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish little green land lizard made of smooth clay
The lizard has a thick, curled tail, a happy stubby snout, and oversized soulful eyes
Chunky, rounded legs and body to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay lizard sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a land-prey meat diet for a children's matching game. No text.
